title: Decode Ways
statement:
A message containing letters from A-Z can be encoded into numbers using the following mapping:
'A' -> "1"
'B' -> "2"
...
'Z' -> "26"

To decode an encoded message, all digits must be grouped into valid single-digit (1-9) or two-digit (10-26) numbers. Given a string s containing only digits, return the number of ways to decode it.
constraints: s contains only digits and may contain leading zero(s)
The encoded string will not start with '0' in the test cases

visibleExamples.explanation: "06" cannot be decoded because '0' cannot map to any letter
